name: Vámosoroszi (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vámosoroszi: a quartered red and white shield with ears of grain, a church, a wavy stripe and a tree, within a red and yellow baroque frame inscribed VÁMOSOROSZI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vámosoroszi arms in a baroque frame
